title: Reading the test's decision branch
description: You can follow a two-sample test result into its printed interpretation.

steps.description: You compare samples A and B with equal_var set to False. The recording prints t equal to 2.88 and p equal to 0.0055.

steps.question: Which branch does the recorded p value select?
steps.answer: It selects the first branch because 0.0055 is below 0.05.

steps.description: You see the message describing evidence that the designs differ. That message follows the threshold comparison in this run.
The alternative branch describes the other threshold outcome and distinguishes missing evidence from proof of sameness. Those alternative messages are absent from the supplied output.
